title: A Safety and Efficacy Study of NAC in Patients With TA-TMA
brief_summary: HSCT associated thrombotic microangiopathy(TA-TMA) is a heterogeneous, fatal disorder seen within 100 days post-transplant and presents with thrombocytopenia, hemolysis, acute renal failure, mental status changes and involvement of other organs. N-Acetylcysteine (NAC) is a small, simple molecule that began as a generic drug almost 40 years ago. It has since been approved by the FDA for many indications. The investigators conducted an prospective clinical trial to evaluate the safety and efficiency of NAC in patients with TA-TMA.
